about: Phosphor's status for Update All's items: safe, guard (Phosphor blocks it; Allow overrides), warn (works, with a catch), keep (Phosphor leaves it alone). Anything not here is untested. Keys: var:<variable>, db:<database id>, entry:<menu>/<title>; menus: a menu id prefix for all of its entries.

game_artwork_.note: Box art and pictures: Phosphor's Local files source can use them.

game_manuals_.note: Manuals: nothing of Phosphor's is touched.

arcade_organizer_.note: Arcade Organizer options: Phosphor's library skips its _Organized folders.

pocket_.note: Analogue Pocket tools: nothing of Phosphor's is touched.

system_video_.note: Update All's CRT video mode: Phosphor leaves it as Update All sets it.

names_txt_.note: Core names for MiSTer's own menu: Phosphor's library uses its own names.

analogue_pocket_.note: Analogue Pocket tools: nothing of Phosphor's is touched.

var:main_updater.note: MiSTer-devel's cores, Main and menu. Phosphor keeps its own Main and menu core after each run.

db:theypsilon/RetroAchievementsDB_MiSTer.note: odelot's RetroAchievements cores: built into Phosphor's Main, which stays for them.

db:MultiDatabases/physical-disc.note: Physical CD support is built into Phosphor's Main, which stays for it.

db:MultiDatabases/maldita-castilla.note: A hybrid core: Phosphor's Main starts its engine itself.

db:MultiDatabases/sonic-mania.note: Phosphor runs it with its own build of the game's Main (today's Main, Phosphor's menu). Needs Data.rsdk from your copy.

db:MultiDatabases/duke3d.note: Runs inside Phosphor's Main. Needs duke3d.grp from your copy.

db:MultiDatabases/mister-quake.note: Runs inside Phosphor's Main. Needs PAK0.PAK from your copy.

db:MultiDatabases/3s-arm.note: Phosphor runs it with its own build of the game's Main (today's Main, Phosphor's menu).

db:MultiDatabases/nblood.note: Works, with its own Main (its source isn't published): Phosphor's in-game menu isn't there while it runs.

db:MultiDatabases/dreamster.note: Takes over the screen Phosphor uses.

db:MultiDatabases/solarus.note: Takes over the screen Phosphor uses.

db:MultiDatabases/diablo.note: Starts its own launcher that takes over the screen.

db:MiSTerOrganize/MiSTer_Frontier.note: Another main menu: it replaces Phosphor.

entry:frontends_menu/Zaparoo Frontend.note: Another main menu: it replaces Phosphor's Main. Phosphor's own Zaparoo support works without it.

db:degauss.note: Another main menu: it replaces Phosphor.

entry:frontends_menu/Stock MiSTer UI.note: MiSTer's own menu: Phosphor runs over it.

db:ZaparooProject/Zaparoo_MiSTer.note: Zaparoo Core: Phosphor tracks the games its cards start.

var:arcade_organizer.note: Phosphor's library skips the _Organized folders, so games aren't listed twice.

db:mrext/all.note: Its remote takes over MiSTer's menu and starts cores behind Phosphor's back.

var:mistersam_files_downloader.note: Phosphor's screen saver can hand over to it when idle.

var:anime0t4ku_mister_scripts.note: Its FTP save sync, Syncthing, DAV browser and clock scripts start at boot and clash with Phosphor's own (cloud sync, clock, file sharing).

db:MultiDatabases/cifs-scripts.note: Mounts a network share at boot over the folders Phosphor's library and backups use; Phosphor has its own network share settings.

db:MultiDatabases/mister-dvd.note: Phosphor starts the DVD player only when a DVD plays.

db:chipster6502/MiSTer_monitor_DB.note: Game art on a second screen: reads what's running, changes nothing.

db:MultiDatabases/mister-hifi.note: Takes over the screen Phosphor uses.

db:MultiDatabases/misterfin.note: Starts at boot and takes over the screen Phosphor uses.

var:retrospy/retrospy-MiSTer.note: A controller viewer: reads input, changes nothing.

var:autoreboot.note: Phosphor's safe stop runs before the restart.

entry:system_options_menu/Linux Updates.note: A MiSTer Linux update can put some settings back to stock; Phosphor's restore points can roll it back. Edge Linux replaces the Linux Phosphor runs on and is untested with it.

entry:system_options_menu/CRT Video Mode.note: Phosphor leaves Update All's video mode as it sets it.

entry:system_options_menu/CRT Screen Pos.note: Phosphor leaves it as Update All sets it.

var:encc_forks.note: Which Main distribution: the standard one is safe; DB9 / SNAC8 and AitorGomez are guarded.

entry:tools_and_scripts_menu/Analogue Po.note: Analogue Pocket tools: nothing of Phosphor's is touched.

db:MultiDatabases/disc-tools.note: A script you start from MiSTer's Scripts folder to rip or burn CDs: it doesn't start at boot or replace anything of Phosphor's. Phosphor saves a copy of a game disc itself too (Settings › Discs); don't use both on the same disc at once.

entry:other_cores_menu/Hybrid Cores.note: Hybrid FPGA/ARM cores: Phosphor's Main starts their engines itself.

entry:extra_content_menu/Game Manuals (E.note: Manuals: nothing of Phosphor's is touched.

var:i2c2oled_files_downloader.note: Core art on a small i2c display: reads what's running, changes nothing of Phosphor's.

var:tty2oled_files_downloader.note: Core art on a small display over USB serial: reads what's running, changes nothing of Phosphor's.

db9.note: DB9 / SNAC8 support is built into Phosphor's Main; this distribution would replace it.

aitorgomez.note: Its Main replaces Phosphor's; its loading screen and Zaparoo features are built into Phosphor's.
